text: 【2026年中央国库现金管理商业银行定期存款（二十二期）招投标 本期操作量1000亿元】财政部、中国人民银行定于2026年11月13日上午9:00至9:30，通过中国人民银行中央国库现金管理商业银行定期存款业务系统进行2026年中央国库现金管理商业银行定期存款（二十二期）招投标。本期操作量1000亿元，期限1个月。
text_en: [Bidding for the 2026 Central Treasury Cash Management Commercial Bank Time Deposit (22nd tranche), with an operation volume of 100 billion yuan] The Ministry of Finance and the People's Bank of China will conduct the bidding for the 2026 Central Treasury Cash Management Commercial Bank Time Deposit (22nd tranche) from 9:00 to 9:30 a.m. on November 13, 2026, through the PBOC's central treasury cash management commercial bank time deposit business system. The operation volume for this tranche is 100 billion yuan, with a term of 1 month.
